summary: Short, very steep residential kerb with houses 12 m away.

best_section.where: Gregory Street south kerb, just east of the corner

drivers.seclusion: Three houses within 13 m on the section's own side; homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb room exists beside a sealed street, but the grade is far too steep to sleep on.
drivers.convention: A few cars park along the kerb; no signs.

sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the verge; houses to the south.
